$comment: Tests that are not parallel-safe on the SQLite desktop profile (the `serial` marker; tests/conftest.py enforces this file). Every entry names the criterion (H2 = a child process must meet a wall-clock barrier; H3 = the test asserts an elapsed-time bound) and the resource at `path:line` that makes it true. A marked test without an entry, and an entry matching nothing on a full-suite run, both fail; the resource line must exist. The Postgres lane keeps these tests in its parallel pool.

entries.why: a child process must meet the sandbox's 1.0 s liveness barrier and the host watchdog budgets, which a loaded box can miss
asserts elapsed < 0.5 s against a 0.05 s probe timeout
